record.title: halo puck — the Ø31.874 x 7.98 mm enclosure: PC crown as the diaphragm, LDS carrier, stamped stainless press-and-twist door, sprung contacts, a Ø20 x 0.22 mm bender, and a CR2032
record.why: design.py builds all ten solids, check() finds no interference across 45 pairs, and eight measured checks read the finished solids: the assembly's bounding box is 31.874 x 31.874 x 7.980 mm (SPEC.md §4 to 0.001 mm), every stepped diameter §4 lists is present on a solid, the annulus out to Apple's Ø37.31 antenna keep-out is empty of halo material, and the bayonet passes five kernel probes including the two that must FAIL for the mechanism to be a mechanism. What is NOT measured, and says so: the sounder's SPL, the IP67 rating and the contacts' real spring rate — all three are physical tests, listed in docs/MECHANICAL.md.
record.frame: origin on the axis at the lowest point of the battery door's outer face (Apple's own drawing datum); +z toward the crown apex at z = 7.980; +x through the 6 o'clock bayonet ledge. Every part is BUILT in this frame, so every placement in the assembly is the identity — a concentric product has one datum and no transform to get wrong.
